cpuProfile.scope: One 30-second main-thread sample. Sampling overhead affects timing; not an A/B or capacity measurement. Loopback inspector closed afterward; same live PID.

replay.scope: Same seeded 0/1/30 player scenarios, three seeds, alternating BAAB pairs, 400 frames each. Full snapshots, players, progress, food, hazards and shots exactly equal. In-process Windows physics; excludes networking, database and browser rendering.

verification.method: One full Linux regression on final code; targeted Windows physics tests; deterministic identical replay; mixed local HTTP/WS and WAL recovery. No repeated full suite or unrelated UI tests.

assessment.scope: Server and WebSocket clients only; no browser rendering or long-duration guarantee.

limitations: Live sessions before and after restart differ. Do not attribute their overall p95 difference to this patch or claim improved full-room CPU.
Only the empty-room fixture has a clear measured speedup (mean 35.45 to 19.21 ms per 360 timed steps). Populated fixtures are noisy.
Mixed test lasted two minutes, with one full room and five lobby clients; it is not maximum capacity, long-term stability or a browser FPS test. Rare state gaps up to 282.38 ms remain.
New large VPS load was not run: only about 0.8 GiB disk and 7 GiB available RAM remained before maintenance, with retained backups. No old backups or history were deleted.

No real VK payments or full event/alchemy matrix in this run. Persistence modules unchanged; no repeated isolated-PG suite. Actual live world and auxiliary were fully compared to PostgreSQL around deployment.
300000 CCU, independent multi-host room deployment and removal of remaining world/table copies are not achieved.

initialFailures.reason: New hazard fixture expected zero instead of normal replenishment to 40. During correction the early return was replaced by break to preserve empty-room cleanup and final refill; final targeted file set 63/63.

First pre-open probe arrived after listener readiness but before backend initialization completed (automatic maintenance). No entry opening or world write occurred. Deployment gate now waits for both backend readiness and fresh PG checkpoint; second full verification retained.

nextSteps: Profile/optimize populated-room simulation and worker packet preparation with identical replay.
Continue addressed profile/history and independent-room candidates without weakening durable ACKs.
Restore host disk/RAM reserve before increasing the real mixed network load; retain all backups.
